description: CASE with an operand, branches and an else branch.

cypher.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN CASE p.age WHEN $p0 THEN $p1 WHEN $p2 THEN $p3 ELSE $p4 END AS age_group

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN CASE p.age WHEN $p0 THEN $p1 WHEN $p2 THEN $p3 ELSE $p4 END AS age_group $$, %s) AS (age_group agtype)

iso_gql.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN CASE p.age WHEN $p0 THEN $p1 WHEN $p2 THEN $p3 ELSE $p4 END AS age_group

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (CASE p.age WHEN $p0 THEN $p1 WHEN $p2 THEN $p3 ELSE $p4 END AS age_group))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (CASE p.age WHEN $p0 THEN $p1 WHEN $p2 THEN $p3 ELSE $p4 END AS age_group))
